children: LAUNCHES BOND ISSUE WITH OPTION TO CONVERT INTO NEW SHARES AND/OR EXCHANGE FOR EXISTING SHARES (OCEANES), MATURING IN 2032, WITH A NOMINAL VALUE OF EUR 380 MILLION
CONCURRENT OFFER TO PARTIALLY REPURCHASE ITS OUTSTANDING OCEANES MATURING IN 2027 VIA A REVERSE BOOK-BUILDING PROCESS
BONDS WILL HAVE A NOMINAL VALUE OF 100,000 EUROS EACH, WILL BEAR INTEREST AT A FIXED ANNUAL RATE OF BETWEEN 1.125 PER CENT AND 1.625 PER CENT
